title: M/S Baba Floor Ata Mills And Another v. State Of U.P. And 3 Others
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
disposition: Writ disposed; appeal before Appellate Authority left open.
headnote: Second writ after a final assessment order is disposed of. The petitioner may appeal to the Appellate Authority and may there raise the ground that Clause 6.8(c)(iii) of the Electricity Supply Code, 2005 was not followed.
facts: M/S Baba Floor Ata Mills and another filed a second writ petition in the Allahabad High Court after a final assessment order. In the earlier petition, Writ-C No. 36329 of 2023, only a provisional assessment order had been placed before the Court, which had observed that the petitioners could challenge the assessment once a final order was passed. The final assessment order having since been made, they returned to the writ court. Instructions filed on the day of hearing were taken on record.

holding_units.topic: Appeal against final assessment including a 6.8(c)(iii) ground
holding_units.holding: Once the final assessment order has been passed, the writ petitioner may file an appeal before the Appellate Authority and may raise before that authority the grievance that Clause 6.8(c)(iii) of the Electricity Supply Code, 2005 was not followed. The writ petition is disposed of on that basis.

principle_tags.application: After the final assessment order, the writ was disposed of and the petitioner was left to an appeal before the Appellate Authority, including on the ground that Clause 6.8(c)(iii) was not followed.
The Court did not examine the final assessment or compliance with Clause 6.8(c)(iii) and treated the appellate authority as the forum for that grievance.

not_decided.point: Whether Clause 6.8(c)(iii) of the Electricity Supply Code, 2005 was followed in the final assessment, and the merits of that assessment
not_decided.note: Left open for the petitioner to raise before the Appellate Authority.
